policies.title: How YouTube recommendations work
policies.boundedStatement: Recommendations are personalized from multiple signals and context; the documentation does not promise distribution for a particular editorial format.

policies.title: Recommendation Guidelines
policies.boundedStatement: Content may be allowed yet ineligible for recommendation; eligibility does not guarantee recommendation or reach.

policies.title: How TikTok recommends videos #ForYou
policies.boundedStatement: The For You feed ranks from multiple user-interaction, video-information, and device/account factors; no single factor or format guarantees distribution.

policies.title: Suggested posts in feed
policies.boundedStatement: Suggested content is evaluated for professional relevance, quality, context beyond the poster network, topical coherence, promotion, and feedback; suggestion is not guaranteed.
